title: Lesson 42 - I'm Having It Fixed Tomorrow

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Thanks for the precise report. The contractor knows which rail you mean. We can have it inspected tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Good. I'm having it fixed tomorrow only if the work is within the approved scope. What exactly will the contractor do first?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: She'll check the rail, both brackets and the wall anchors. If only the loose bracket needs adjustment, she'll secure it during the visit.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Are we getting the whole rail replaced?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: No. We're getting the rail checked. Replacement is not included unless the inspection shows that adjustment is not enough.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: That distinction needs to be in the confirmation. Does the quote include the inspection and the adjustment?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Yes. The quote is one hundred forty dollars. It includes the call-out fee, up to one hour of labor and standard fasteners worth up to twenty-five dollars.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: How much will that cost if a special bracket is needed?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: We don't know until the inspection. There won't be any extra charge unless we approve it first.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: I need approval before any work takes the total above one hundred forty dollars.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Understood. I'll ask the contractor to stop after the inspection and call me with a revised amount if anything additional is needed.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: And the appointment is confirmed for what time?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: She is arriving between nine and ten. The lobby rail will remain unused until she finishes and facilities signs off.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: What would you do if the revised amount were much higher?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: If I were you, I'd ask for the written findings and compare repair with replacement. The main trade-off is immediate access versus a larger unplanned cost.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: The safest option is to authorize only the current scope tomorrow. We can revisit anything else if the inspection provides new evidence.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Agreed. I'll send a note that says: inspect L-2, adjust the loose bracket if standard work is enough, and get approval before the total exceeds one hundred forty dollars.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Please also request an itemized invoice. Then we'll know what was inspected, what was done and what was charged.
